Whatnot sales import

Export your show's sales report from Whatnot and drop the CSV here. Coins already in your app are marked sold at the gross post-coupon price (flagged net pending) — upload the earnings report later to finalize the true net.

Whatnot earnings — finalize net

1–5 days after the show, export the earnings report and drop it here. Every sale you logged at gross gets rewritten to the true settled net and its net pending flag cleared.

Select coins to print

Add every coin whose SKU falls in a range. Same series stays in series (e.g. A-0018–A-0024); mixed prefixes (e.g. P-0017–A-0064) sweep ALL series by number.

Tag size

Set your printer to Print on both sides · Flip on long edge. Pages alternate front/back: the story prints mirrored on the back so it lands exactly behind its logo panel. Each story panel carries a tiny SKU in the corner so you can spot-check front/back alignment.

CSV exports

Select coins, then export a Whatnot listing report or an eBay bulk-upload file. eBay rows auto-sort into ancient-coin categories — adjust any per coin below.

Add every coin whose SKU falls in a range. Same series (e.g. A-0018 to A-0024) stays in that series. Mixed prefixes (e.g. P-0017 to A-0064) sweep ALL series by number. Sold & incoming coins are skipped.

🔒 Financial PIN — locks Dashboard & Expenses tabs

On a staff device, just leave the PIN unset (or don't share it) — those tabs stay locked there. This is a deterrent, not bank-grade security: it stops casual access on shared devices.
